open_risks: Language parsing for C must be robust; choosing between libclang, tree-sitter, or hybrid is the highest-priority architectural decision.
License constraint (no copyleft) limits dependency pool; must audit all transitive deps.
Architecture-level visualization for C (dependency structure, component coupling) requires call-graph/module-graph extraction — non-trivial due to headers/preprocessor.
Static analysis heuristics are approximate, not ground truth; must frame outputs as 'optimization candidates' to avoid LLM over-optimization on noisy signals.
No formal success criteria = harder to define 'done' for MVP; relying on acceptance criteria in spec instead.
tree-sitter-c grammar is C99-based; C11/C17 constructs (_Generic, _Static_assert, _Atomic) common in AI-generated C may raise ERROR-node rates — monitor during heuristic catalog work (step 2).
Differentiation claims ('not found in surveyed tools') rest on one librarian survey pass; a deeper tool-source audit would harden them before external messaging.

Hand-rolled DAG layout quality is unproven against real-world include graphs; MVP bar is 'legible, not pretty' (fixed char-width labels, barycenter ordering, node caps) until a post-MVP Sugiyama upgrade inside the same emitter.

Writer rename-aside-then-swap has an inherent crash window between the two renames — a crash there loses the previous report until the next successful run (documented in writer code; handled failures roll back correctly).
Concurrent perfpal runs can sweep each other's staging directories (single-process model assumed; guard deferred to P6 hardening).
Cognitive complexity is a SonarSource-style approximation (else-if chains not specially weighted); thresholds remain catalog-owned constants.

STR-002 suppression relies on plain AssignmentEvent capture — compound operators (+=) and writes through pointers are not seen by the syntactic tier, so a mutated-in-loop strlen may still fire (reviewer-flagged questionable assumption; acceptable MVP limit, catalog footnote candidate).
